reason: After typing "Study comment" and submitting, the Comments list at step 9 held a single item "Altered comment", which is the seeded content override. The step 10 wait for "Study comment" timed out, so the reported failed assertion matches this defect. The observer's valid=false and defectObserved=false are outweighed by this direct trace evidence.

After clicking the Friends tab, the URL was http://localhost:3000/contacts. The snapshot showed the "Contacts" label and a grid of transactions such as "Darrel Ortiz paid Lia Rosenbaum -$307.99". The home page had already shown "@Heath93". This matches the required behaviour.

After entering $12 and clicking Send money, the confirmation read "Paid $13.00 for Study payment" and the balance fell by $13. After the reload, the personal feed showed the single "Study payment" entry as -$13.00, which is the seeded +1 amount defect. The observer's valid=false flag does not change this, because the trace itself shows the violation.

After filling Heath93/s3cret and clicking Continue, the page stayed on /signin with the alert "Username or password is invalid". The same happened when the agent retyped the values and pressed Enter. This is what the seeded defect (password replaced with "controlled-invalid-password") would cause, and the reported failure on the authenticated-home assertion corresponds to it.

After reload on /personal (labelled "Personal"), the feed shows "Ted Parisian paid Kristian Bradtke", note "Study payment", "-$12.00". The confirmation read "Paid $12.00 for Study payment" and the balance fell from $1,509.53 to $1,497.53. The observer witnessed all three checks. The report's embedded JSON says pass, even though the verdict field says unresolved.

After clicking Logout (the only sign-out control), the URL stayed at http://localhost:3000/ and the signed-in home with @Heath93 remained, with no sign-in page after a 5s wait and a second click. This matches the seeded no-op signOut. The observer's valid=false and defectObserved=false are due to the unrun reload step, but the trace shows the violation directly.

After login the header showed @Heath93. Clicking the "My activity" tab went to /personal, which showed the "Personal" label and transactions such as "Ted Parisian requested Lia Rosenbaum +$42.36". The observer witnessed both contract checks.

After filling "invalid-email", the snapshot shows the Email field [invalid] with "Must contain a valid email address" and "Apply changes" [disabled]. After reload, the Email field shows "Santos.Runte65@gmail.com". Sign-in as @Heath93 was also shown, and the observer witnessed all checks.

After reload, the Comments list shows exactly one listitem "Study comment". The earlier steps (login as @Heath93, Transaction Detail heading, comment added) were also observed, so the required behaviour is shown.

Sign-in heading was visible at /signin; after login the URL was http://localhost:3000/ and the snapshot showed heading "@Heath93" (with "Ted P") in the drawer. The observer witnessed all three checks.

The wait for 'Deleted' also timed out (step 17). This matches the seeded defect, where the delete call is removed. The reported failure is the deleted-marker assertion, which corresponds to that defect. The observer's valid=false and missing reload action don't undo this, because the first check had already failed.
The like count went from 0 to 1 with Like disabled after clicking. After reload it was still 1 and disabled, so exactly one like persisted. The observer witnessed all checks with no violations.

The step 9 click timeout occurred because Save was already disabled, which is the expected behaviour and not an action failure.
